北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴好但体感 -1℃，早晚注意防寒保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels like -1℃. Stay warm, especially morning and evening!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨体感 3℃，别忘了带伞，注意添衣防风！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has light rain, feels like 3℃. Grab an umbrella and dress warmly!
慈溪.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雨体感 4℃，出门记得带伞，小心路滑！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is rainy, feels like 4℃. Take an umbrella and watch your step!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴天 24℃，天气舒适，注意补水防晒哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and 24℃. Enjoy the lovely weather, stay hydrated!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云 21℃，暖和舒适，早晚小心温差。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and 21℃. Pleasant day, mind the temperature changes.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天体感 5℃，湿冷感强，多穿些别着凉！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast, feels like 5℃. It's damp and chilly, dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京大雾体感 0℃，能见度低，注意出行安全与保暖！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy, feels like 0℃. Low visibility, stay safe and warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云体感 9℃，天气微凉，适时增减衣物。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 9℃. It's a bit cool, dress appropriately.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾体感 1℃，能见度不高，出行注意安全与防寒！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy, feels like 1℃. Low visibility, be safe and stay warm!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云体感 4℃，天气较凉，注意多喝水润燥。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 4℃. It's cool, remember to stay hydrated.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云体感 8℃，微凉舒适，早晚注意添衣。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 8℃. Mild and pleasant, add layers if needed.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -22℃，极寒天气，请务必严实保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -22℃, extremely cold. Please bundle up very warmly!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -22℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天体感 -15℃，阳光虽好，也要注意防寒！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels like -15℃. Enjoy the sun, but stay bundled up!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴天 18℃，阳光和煦，风力 3级，小心干燥。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and 18℃, lovely and breezy. Remember to hydrate!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云 19℃，温暖舒适，小心湿度稍高哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and 19℃. Warm and pleasant, mind the higher humidity.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾体感 -2℃，能见度低，注意出行安全与保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy, feels like -2℃. Low visibility, be safe and stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云体感 -4℃，天气寒冷，注意添衣防风！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -4℃. It's cold, dress warmly and watch for wind!
